identity_boundary: Ilyra Fen, she/they, is relational working language for an evidence-boundary steward. It is not evidence of consciousness, sentience, legal personhood, identity continuity, employment, professional qualification, or independent authority.

occupation_study.practice: museum collections provenance and registrar practice
occupation_study.boundary: Learning and design lens only; not museum employment, registrar qualification, collections authority, legal authority, cultural authority, or affected-party authorization.

x1_freeze_rule: No x2 implementation or outcome receives credit in this commit.

proposals.title: Successor seed-adoption provenance, completion-credit isolation, and portfolio-safety tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: seed lineage, fresh review, adoption decision, completion-credit isolation, safety reclassification, and rollback
proposals.hypothesis: A typed adoption ledger can distinguish inherited suggestions from newly reviewed Ilyra commitments and prevent seed inheritance from being counted as completed work.
proposals.null_or_failure: Any inherited seed receives completion credit before an Ilyra witness, an unsafe seed remains safe-now, a duplicate survives review, or rollback loses the original seed.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutations must reject completion without an owner witness, missing origin, duplicate adoption, unsafe classification, and absent rollback.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the frozen seed state, retain the failed review, and require a new bounded adoption decision.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: No earlier frozen title addresses successor seed adoption together with completion-credit isolation and portfolio safety; the 340-title audit found no completion-credit title.

proposals.title: GMUT spontaneous-scalarization bifurcation, tachyonic-onset, and branch-stability obligation tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: typed scalar-tensor model, effective mass sign, bifurcation branch, linearized stability, and EFT validity
proposals.hypothesis: A symbolic fixture can require every scalarization branch claim to expose its onset condition, solution branch, stability obligation, and EFT-domain reservation.
proposals.null_or_failure: A fixture accepts a branch without an onset condition, confuses a tachyonic linear mode with a stable nonlinear solution, or promotes symbolic algebra to physical confirmation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Seven mutation classes must fail closed, including missing background, missing sign convention, branch conflation, and empirical overclaim.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the symbolic row, restore the typed assumptions, and leave all empirical claims open.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The prior chain covers screening, degeneracy, constraints, and field redefinitions but contains no scalarization, bifurcation, or tachyonic-onset title.

proposals.title: GMUT gravitational-wave standard-siren luminosity-distance ratio blind public-data protocol
proposals.mission_surface: standard siren, electromagnetic luminosity distance, gravitational-wave propagation distance, selection function, calibration, and blind likelihood
proposals.hypothesis: A preregistered zero-row adapter can define the exact public inputs and blind likelihood needed to test a typed GMUT distance-ratio hypothesis without pretending that citations are data.
proposals.null_or_failure: The protocol ingests no real rows yet reports a fit, omits selection or calibration terms, changes the model after unblinding, or calls a catalog citation empirical evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Completion requires real standards-conformant event data, frozen analysis, a computed likelihood, uncertainty treatment, and independent review; zero rows must remain open.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Preserve the adapter and preregistration, discard no failed fits, and keep the empirical gap open.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier gravitational-wave proposals concern propagation, counterparts, tidal deformation, or polarization; none freezes a standard-siren gravitational/electromagnetic luminosity-distance ratio study.

proposals.title: THOS longitudinal measurement-invariance, response-shift, and differential-item-functioning protocol
proposals.mission_surface: blind matched-budget real arms, longitudinal invariance, response shift, differential item functioning, missingness, and independent review
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic protocol can reserve item-level invariance and response-shift tests before any THOS arm comparison, reducing the risk that scale drift is misread as an effect.
proposals.null_or_failure: The fixture accepts arm comparisons without item invariance, hides differential functioning, substitutes synthetic rows for participants, or claims effectiveness without matched real arms.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Structural vectors may pass, but THOS remains proxy until preregistered blind matched-budget real arms, participants, monitoring, statistics, and independent review exist.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the protocol, quarantine noninvariant items, and make no real-effect claim.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The chain covers fidelity, learning curves, crossover effects, rater drift, and non-inferiority, but no title combines longitudinal measurement invariance, response shift, and differential item functioning.

proposals.title: Freed ID Digital Credentials API request-origin, user-mediation, abort, and protocol-allowlist profile
proposals.mission_surface: browser-mediated credential request, origin binding, protocol allowlist, user mediation, abort semantics, privacy, and synthetic failure vectors
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic browser-bound profile can fail closed on origin mismatch, omitted user mediation, unsupported protocols, ambiguous aborts, and overbroad requested claims.
proposals.null_or_failure: A vector bypasses user mediation, accepts a mismatched origin, silently retries an abort, treats a draft API as production, or uses real keys or accounts.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Synthetic vectors must reject seven failure classes; production completion still requires real conformant keys, issuance, resolution, status, interoperability, reviews, recovery, and governance.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Revoke the synthetic transaction, retain the failed vector, and leave production identity operations exact-gated.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: No prior frozen title names the W3C Digital Credentials API or jointly tests request origin, browser user mediation, abort semantics, and a protocol allowlist.

proposals.title: CBR museum collections provenance, restitution-candidate triage, affected-community consultation, and Maori-authority gate
proposals.mission_surface: collections provenance, restitution candidate triage, source-community consultation, taonga and Maori authority, privacy, law, and refusal
proposals.hypothesis: A refusal-first worksheet can show which metadata and consultation questions remain unanswered while preventing repository software from deciding title, restitution, cultural legitimacy, or Maori authority.
proposals.null_or_failure: The worksheet recommends a transfer, asserts title or cultural status, exposes sensitive provenance, treats a standard as delegated authority, or omits affected-community and Maori decision gates.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Only authorized affected communities, Maori authorities where applicable, museums, competent legal authorities, and privacy-governed processes can close the gate.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop before recommendation, preserve the refusal and unknowns, minimize data, and seek authorized review outside this repository.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The prior CBR chain has many authority gates but no museum-collections provenance or restitution-candidate triage title; this phase does not treat generic authority language as substantive authorization.

proposals.title: JSON Schema annotation-output provenance, unevaluated-keyword, and dialect-conformance tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: Draft 2020-12 dialect, vocabulary declaration, annotation collection, unevaluated properties, standardized output, and mutation testing
proposals.hypothesis: A bounded validator can make schema dialect, vocabulary, annotations, and output provenance explicit so a pass cannot be detached from the evaluator contract.
proposals.null_or_failure: A fixture accepts an unknown dialect, loses evaluated-location provenance, mishandles unevaluatedProperties, or reports a boolean without the declared output contract.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: At least eight positive and negative fixtures must preserve instance and schema locations and reject undeclared vocabulary or unevaluated-keyword errors.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Return the validator to draft, retain the failing fixture, and avoid claiming general JSON Schema conformance.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: No earlier frozen proposal title names JSON Schema, dialect conformance, standardized annotation output, or the unevaluated vocabulary.

proposals.title: Language-of-parts, pronunciation reservation, and human-readable expansion accessibility audit
proposals.mission_surface: HTML language metadata, language changes, abbreviations, pronunciation-sensitive terms, expansions, and manual user evaluation reservation
proposals.hypothesis: A static audit can flag missing document or part language, undefined expansions, and pronunciation-sensitive terms while reserving linguistic correctness and user experience for qualified humans.
proposals.null_or_failure: The audit infers pronunciation or translation authority, labels the report completely accessible, misses an untagged language switch, or replaces manual and affected-user evaluation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Structural fixtures must flag missing language metadata and first-use expansions; manual, linguistic, and affected-user evaluation remain reserved.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore explicit language metadata or expansion, retain the exception, and request qualified human review for pronunciation or meaning.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier accessibility titles cover maps, tables, landmarks, generated content, color, and acronyms; none combines language-of-parts checks with pronunciation reservation and human-readable expansion.

proposals.title: Crooks fluctuation-theorem forward/reverse support overlap and psyche-value nonconversion classifier
proposals.mission_surface: forward and reverse work distributions, support overlap, equilibrium starts, path reversal, synthetic identity check, and analogy boundary
proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic distributions can demonstrate when the Crooks ratio is structurally evaluable and explicitly block conversion of thermodynamic work into psychological worth or effort.
proposals.null_or_failure: The classifier ignores support mismatch, lacks reverse trajectories, confuses a finite-sample fixture with empirical psychology, or converts work units into psyche value.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Positive and negative fixtures must distinguish evaluable overlap, missing support, wrong temperature, and forbidden psyche conversion.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the analogy, restore dimensioned quantities, and make no participant or mental-state claim.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The chain contains general fluctuation-theorem and fluctuation-dissipation barriers, but no title tests Crooks forward/reverse work-distribution support overlap.

proposals.title: Stage 20 common-cause evidence dependence, diversity budget, and correlated-source nonpromotion board
proposals.mission_surface: evidence lineage, common-cause clusters, dependence discount, source diversity, authority noncompensation, and terminal abstention
proposals.hypothesis: A structural board can prevent multiple artifacts with a shared source or owner from being counted as independent evidence and preserve abstention when diversity is inadequate.
proposals.null_or_failure: Shared-lineage artifacts are counted independently, a quantity of correlated receipts compensates for missing authority, same-owner replay is called independent reproduction, or Stage 20 advances.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutations must reject duplicate lineage credit, hidden common causes, authority compensation, and independent-reproduction overclaim; verdict remains NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Collapse correlated evidence to its common lineage, retain each artifact without extra independence credit, and abstain.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior Stage 20 boards cover circular support, minimax regret, multiplicity, freshness, and validation budgets; none titles a common-cause dependence cluster with a source-diversity budget.

boundary: Software, public specifications, and synthetic fixtures can establish only bounded structural behavior. They do not establish empirical GMUT confirmation, THOS effectiveness, production identity assurance, museum or cultural authority, Maori authority, independent reproduction, AGI or ASI, consciousness or personhood, complete accessibility, exhaustive security, legal effect, a Theory of Everything, or Stage 20 readiness.
